record.field: Only one threshold is allowed by box and year.
Only one 1099 amount is allowed by recipient, box and year.
To file Forms 1099, you must add an Employer Identification Number to the party of company "%(company)s".
To file Form 1099, you must add a taxpayer identification number (EIN, SSN, ITIN or ATIN) to party "%(party)s".
The taxpayer identification number of party "%(party)s" must have 9 digits.
To file Form 1099, you must set a complete address (street, city and postal code) on party "%(party)s".
